rows.ja: 供給元(燃料・機器・建設)
電力の購入予定先(データセンター・エネルギー)

companies.name: セントラス・エナジー

relations.text: Meta向け発電所の燃料として、高純度低濃縮ウラン(HALEU)の供給契約を2026年9月に締結
relations.text_en: Signed a HALEU supply agreement in September 2026 to fuel powerhouses planned for Meta

source.label: Oklo 10-Q(2026年7-9月期)
source.quote: we entered into a HALEU supply agreement with Centrus to support the deployment of powerhouses for Meta, subject to certain conditions

relations.text: Metaの資金の一部が、燃料発注の前払いとしてCentrusに直接支払われた
relations.text_en: Part of Meta’s funding was paid directly to Centrus as a credit toward fuel orders

source.label: Oklo 10-Q(2026年7-9月期)
source.quote: an initial funding amount from Meta was released from escrow and paid directly to Centrus as a credit towards fuel orders

companies.name: シーメンス・エナジー

relations.text: Siemens Energyを主要な供給元の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Siemens Energy among its key suppliers

source.label: Oklo 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The execution, termination, expiration, or failure to renew agreements with our suppliers, including, but not limited to, Siemens Energy, Inc., Amentum Technology Inc., Kiewit, and Centrus

companies.name: アメンタム
companies.sub: 技術・エンジニアリング

relations.text: Amentumを主要な供給元の一社として挙げる
relations.text_en: Names Amentum among its key suppliers

source.label: Oklo 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The execution, termination, expiration, or failure to renew agreements with our suppliers, including, but not limited to, Siemens Energy, Inc., Amentum Technology Inc., Kiewit, and Centrus

relations.text: 2025年1月、Lightbridgeと燃料開発で覚書(MOU)を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a memorandum of understanding with Lightbridge on nuclear fuel in January 2025

source.label: Lightbridge 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In January 2025, we signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Oklo, Inc.

companies.name: メタ・プラットフォームズ

relations.text: オハイオ州の1.2GW発電拠点を巡り、Metaが電力代金を前払いする契約を2026年1月に締結
relations.text_en: Entered a January 2026 agreement under which Meta prepays for power from a planned 1.2 GW campus in Ohio

source.label: Oklo 10-Q(2026年7-9月期)
source.quote: we entered into a prepayment agreement (the "Prepayment Agreement") with Meta Platforms, Inc. ("Meta") that advances plans to develop a 1.2 gigawatt power campus in Pike County, Ohio
source.note: 発電所は建設前で、電力の供給はまだ始まっていません。
source.note_en: The powerhouses are not yet built; no power has been delivered.

relations.text: Equinixと電力購入の意向書(拘束力なし)を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a non-binding letter of intent with Equinix to purchase power

source.label: Oklo 10-Q(2026年7-9月期)
source.quote: we have signed non-binding letters of intent with Equinix, Inc.
source.note: 拘束力のない意向書です。

companies.name: ダイヤモンドバック・エナジー

relations.text: 子会社Diamondback E&Pと電力購入の意向書(拘束力なし)を締結
relations.text_en: Signed a non-binding letter of intent with subsidiary Diamondback E&P

source.label: Oklo 10-Q(2026年7-9月期)
source.note: 拘束力のない意向書です。

relations.text: NVIDIA・ロスアラモス研究所とAIによる燃料・原子炉の解析で協力する契約を2026年4月に発表
relations.text_en: Announced an April 2026 agreement with NVIDIA and Los Alamos on AI-enabled reactor and fuel modeling

source.label: Oklo 10-Q(2026年7-9月期)
source.quote: In April 2026, we announced an agreement with NVIDIA Corporation and Los Alamos National Laboratory

relations.text: Vertivが、データセンター電源の選択肢を探る協業相手としてOkloを挙げる
relations.text_en: Vertiv describes a collaboration with Oklo exploring alternative power for data centers

source.label: Vertiv 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: our collaboration with Oklo reflects exploration of alternative energy solutions that could support future data center power requirements

relations.text: 2023年からOkloの株式に出資(2025年に一部を売却)
relations.text_en: Has held an investment in Oklo since 2023 (sold some shares in 2025)

source.label: Liberty Energy 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The Company holds an investment in Oklo Inc. ("Oklo") made during the three months ended September 30, 2023.

companies.name: ナノ・ニュークリア・エナジー

relations.text: NANO Nuclearが、競合する先進炉の開発企業の一つとしてOkloを挙げる
relations.text_en: NANO Nuclear lists Oklo among developers of competing advanced reactors

source.label: NANO Nuclear Energy 10-K(2025年9月期)
source.quote: These include reactors being designed and developed by TerraPower, X-Energy, GE Hitachi, Holtec, Oklo and Kairos.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
